fields.mechanism: Advanced characterization techniques including X-ray imaging, optical sensing, acoustic field imaging, and spectroscopy to study thermal runaway (TR) mechanism
fields.intervention: Implement multi-sensory monitoring system using X-ray imaging, optical sensors, acoustic sensors, and spectroscopy within the battery pack to detect early thermal runaway initiation
fields.expected_effect: Early detection of thermal runaway in individual cells before propagation to adjacent cells, allowing for targeted suppression while maintaining pack energy density and mass constraints
fields.falsification_test: Simulate thermal runaway in a controlled environment with the monitoring system activated to verify detection occurs before propagation to adjacent cells
fields.mechanism_source_span: This review first examines the causes and consequences of thermal failure, providing didactic mechanistic insights. It then compares recent progress in thermal and electrochemical failure analysis using advanced characterization techniques, including X-ray imaging, optical sensing, acoustic field imaging, and spectroscopy, to study the thermal runaway (TR) mechanism

fields.mechanism: Structural thermal isolation between battery cells to prevent thermal runaway propagation
fields.intervention: Incorporate phase change materials and ceramic thermal barriers between adjacent battery cells within the pack
fields.expected_effect: Contain thermal runaway to the originating cell by absorbing heat and blocking thermal transfer pathways, preventing propagation while maintaining pack energy density
fields.falsification_test: Measure temperature gradients between cells during controlled thermal runaway initiation with and without thermal barriers
